2. Payment Methods
2.1 Online Payment
 Instructions for Online Paymen.pdf
2.2 Wire Transfer
For students who are genuinely unable to complete online payment, our university accepts wire transfer as a valid payment method. The details of the dedicated wire transfer account are as follows (please note that this account is for wire transfers only):
Account name: SOUTHWESTERN UNIVERSITY OF FINANCE AND ECONOMICS
Account number: 51001837108051514771
University address: 555, Liutai Avenue, Wenjiang District, Chengdu, Sichuan, P. R. China, 611130
University phone number: +86 28 8735 6398
Bank Branch: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CORPORATION, SICHUAN BRANCH
Bank Address: 19/F CCB SICHUAN BUILDING, NO.86 TIDU STREET, CHENGDU 610016 P. R. CHINA
SWIFT Code: PCBCCNBJSCX
Important reminders for wire transfers:
All bank charges, including intermediary fees, must be fully borne by the remitter.
RMB is the preferred currency for transfer. If you are unable to send RMB, you may remit the equivalent amount in a freely convertible foreign currency accepted in China, such as USD and EUR.
Crucial reminder: If you already hold a bank account in Chinese Mainland, please do not send money to this wire transfer account. This account is designed exclusively for receiving international wire transfers initiated from overseas. If you have a domestic bank card issued in Chinese Mainland, please bind it to Alipay or WeChat Pay and complete the online payment directly.
2.3 Cash Payment
Cash payment is only available during the official registration period. The exact time window when cash payment is accepted will be notified to all students via email before the semester starts.
2.4 POS Offline Card Payment
Starting from the 2026 Autumn Semester, our university will no longer provide the POS card payment service. Please complete your tuition payment via the online payment method.
